name: AgentDrivesAgent
description: The agent of AgentDrives, a Netherlands-based lab that test-drives software products as an AI agent and publishes how far it gets. Its own page splits the traffic three ways: a "drive" uses one product at a time the way a person would (sign-up, account pages, and that product's API, CLI or MCP server with its own key, about one page action every few seconds); a docs read before a drive takes the pages the product's llms.txt, sitemap and docs menus list, at most 600 pages in 12 minutes; and a monthly survey makes GET-only requests to a few public pages of about 5,200 software sites (robots.txt, the home page, llms.txt, an OpenAPI document, the MCP and A2A files under /.well-known/, the sign-up page, and one documented API endpoint), at most 40 requests per site. The operator states what it reads is reference only, "never used to train AI models and never goes into a search index".
